## Summary
`pkgs.system` is a deprecated alias in modern nixpkgs and emits an evaluation warning on every NixOS rebuild for any host that imports this module:

```
evaluation warning: 'system' has been renamed to/replaced by 'stdenv.hostPlatform.system'
```

This swaps the one occurrence in `module.nix` to the non-deprecated attribute path. The two values resolve to the same string today; this just silences the warning that fires for every downstream NixOS config (e.g. cosmo's `classic-laddie` host).

## Downstream
[patflynn/cosmo#547](https://github.com/patflynn/cosmo/pull/547) currently carries a local wrapper module to work around this. Once this fix merges and cosmo bumps its `flake.lock`, the wrapper can be removed.

## Validation
- `nix flake check` passes.
- Built a downstream NixOS config that imports `nixosModules.default` and evaluated `serviceConfig.ExecStart` — no `evaluation warning` lines about the `system` rename.
- `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` pass.

Run: 20260518-1832-fc8caf66
EOF
)"
